data.action: 对着手镜补好唇色，练习从职业表情切换成亲切笑容。
data.description: 学校空教室，她对着小镜子把制服领口松开、涂上唇膏，对着镜子练习夸张的笑容；镜里镜外两个表情，构图核心是「上戏前的一秒」。
data.promptProse: In an empty classroom, Ai Hayasaka loosens her school collar and applies lipstick while holding a small mirror, then practices an exaggerated smile. Her dark uniform, white collar and red ribbon remain recognizable beneath a blonde side ponytail. Keep her real face and its mirror reflection visible in the medium portrait, with unused desks behind. Warm room light catches the lipstick tube and mirror edge, leaving gentler shadows under the desks.
data.title: 早坂爱 · 放学后的辣妹切换
